'''Vel''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] smuggler associate of [[Gault Rennow]]. During the [[War against Zakuul]] Vel was running weapons to civilians looking to rebel on the planets occupied by the [[Eternal Empire]] for profit. Following the raid on the ''[[Gilded Star]]'' Gault Rennow gave Vel a large loan, hoping for an even bigger profit in the future.<ref name="SWTOR">{{TORcite|exp=kotfe|chapter=14}}</ref>
